title: Compress partial output completions using nested column geometry
statement: For a valid prefix of rank r,the projection modulo the next nested kernel is fixed by the observations. The reported next-column counts are delta_j q^(r-s_j) and q^dim(K_j)-delta_j q^(r-s_j),nonnegative actual affine-set populations. Backward completion counts and actual affine indexing supply conditional samples.

requires: Actual affine column cosets with nested kernels and compatible coordinate ordering
The declared source-fiber population and original-coordinate reconstruction operation
For raw gates:budgeted F2 Ferrers tensor/child-expression and independent original-bank admission
provides: A source-reported positive O(nm)-state partial-output completion engine
assumptions: Nesting and actual directions are indispensable
Two incomparable directions can give equal-rank prefixes with different continuation counts
costs: O(nm) scalar rank states;O(nm^2) for the two-rank phase branch;all acquisition,affine indexing,integer-bit,reconstruction and original-gate checks charged
contract.units: Exact finite-field dimensions, integer populations and rational probabilities; wall-clock observations in seconds.
contract.obstruction: Rank alone loses the next-step geometry for non-nested observation kernels.

evidence.quote: **I completed a positive conditioning construction that counts, finds witnesses, and samples original inputs when only part of a matrix output is observed.** It handles exponentially many possible completed outputs through polynomially many rank states, and it now has both a raw-circuit branch and a separate unit-phase branch.
evidence.range_scope: Governing producer statement; retain the complete source contract and review scope.

body: Proof/code/review originals remain unacquired. Non-nested directions defeat this rank-only state,even for a forest observation pattern;arbitrary masks/shared-input circuits remain open. The phase adapter needs both total rank and distinguished initial-block rank,faithful full module,rank-one socle and unit phase. A tuple/list phase defect,reproducer,repair and corrected receiving are reported,but unavailable as originals. Matched conventional routes agree and show no speed advantage;affine-extension priority is unestablished. Read the exact supporting statement and its applicable conditions. Producer review status is preserved; no new scientific audit or producer-code execution was performed for this insertion.
